subject: math
topicName: College Review Week 1: Ratios, Fractions, and Percents
description: Rebuild the student's ratio, fraction, and percent foundations through a structured week of recall, guided examples, and short drills.
learningObjectives: Convert confidently among fractions, decimals, ratios, and percents
Identify the whole, the part, and the comparison in percent problems
Use proportion reasoning without guessing or cross-multiplying too early
Check whether a percent answer is reasonable before finalizing it
